criteria.text: Diagnosis of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH, WHO Group I) (approval criterion 1).
Patient is not currently being treated with any nitrate product (approval criterion 2).
Patient is 18 years of age or older (approval criterion 3).

notes: Partial encoding from Alaska Medicaid Revatio (sildenafil) Criteria Version 4; last updated 09/06/2012; approved 03/19/2010 and 09/21/2012; effective_date 2012-01-01 retained from archived metadata.
Products: Revatio tablet 20mg; injectable 10mg/12.5mL. This pack is for Revatio, not Viagra.
Encoded: approval criteria 1-3, including the closed WHO Group I PAH indication. Failure to meet approval criteria is the only basis for denial; the source has no additive clinical denial list.
Limitation of use (notes only): efficacy has not been adequately evaluated with concurrent bosentan; concurrent bosentan is not an encoded exclusion.
Length of authorization (notes only): coverage may be approved for up to 12 months.
Dispensing and quantity (notes only): 30-day supply; tablets up to 3 per day (#90 tablets); injection up to 3 per day (#90 vials). max_units is null; quantity is not evaluated.
Documentation verification, limitation of use, authorization duration and dispensing limits require manual review; this pack remains partial. Linked alternatives require their own criteria review.
